name: TAWASOA FOR FACTORING
source: StockAnalysis (audited). Filed here under the exchange code TWSA as well as TAWS: the EGX board carries both codes as separate rows for the same security (identical price, previous close, volume and turnover on the same session), and the two rows carry the same issuer name, Tawasoa For Factoring, differing only in case. The same figures are published under both codes so the financials panel resolves whichever code the reader opens. | extended from stockanalysis.com
